The district, founded in 1889, stretches along the Bright over 912.4 square kilometres and keeps 455.0 km of paved road. Census population: 39,902 in 2020 and 44,675 in 2025. Households used 3,315 megalitres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 7,733.9 million tenge.

matches.title: Lindenmoor district profile (2025)
matches.text: Lindenmoor has 13 schools, which enrolled 4,115 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. Households used 2,151,400 cubic metres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 4,870.4 million tenge.

matches.text: Millbrook has 15 schools, which enrolled 5,562 pupils for the 2025/26 school year.
